name: argus-panoptes
displayName: Argus Panoptes: AI Data Leak Prevention (DLP)
description: Smart DLP Guardrail for VS Code & Antigravity IDE: intercepts AI prompts, detects PII/secrets/Finnish HETU, and prevents leaks to LM Studio, Ollama, and Cloud LLMs.

commands.title: Argus: Scan Selected Text for Sensitive Leaks
Argus: Open Security Dashboard & Audit Log
Argus: Test Connection to Target LLM (LM Studio / Ollama)
Argus: Audit Active AI Agents & Traffic Egress
Argus: Route Global IDE Traffic through Argus Proxy

argus.enabled.description: Enable or disable Argus Panoptes DLP guardrail.

enumDescriptions: Mask (Anonymize): Replaces sensitive data with tokens and unmasks in LLM response
Block: Completely blocks prompt if sensitive data is detected
Confirm: Blocks until a host confirmation flow is available
Audit only: Allows prompt through but logs all detected leaks
argus.mode.description: Action policy when sensitive data or secrets are detected.

argus.proxy.port.description: Local port on which the Argus DLP Proxy listens (default: 8765).

argus.proxy.host.description: Host binding for Argus DLP Proxy.

argus.target.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the target LLM API (e.g. LM Studio: http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1, Ollama: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1).

argus.target.apiKey.description: API Key sent to the target LLM (for LM Studio/Ollama any string works, for OpenAI provide your key).

argus.detectors.apiKeysAndSecrets.description: Detect API keys, JWTs, AWS keys, private SSH keys, and database connection strings.

argus.detectors.piiGeneral.description: Detect emails, phone numbers, IP addresses, and credit cards.

argus.detectors.finnishHetu.description: Detect Finnish Personal Identity Codes (Henkilötunnus / HETU) with checksum verification.

argus.detectors.financialIban.description: Detect International Bank Account Numbers (IBAN) with Mod-97 checksum.

argus.detectors.highEntropyStrings.description: Detect random high-entropy strings (potential unknown secrets/passwords via Shannon Entropy).

argus.agentProtection.blockEnvFiles.description: Antigravity IDE & Agentic protection: block inclusion of .env and secret files in agent context.

argus.customRegexRules.description: Custom regular expressions for detecting project-specific secrets or internal codes.

argus.whitelistedPaths.description: File path glob patterns where secret detection should be ignored (e.g. unit test mocks).

scripts.test: tsc -p ./tsconfig.test.json && node dist/tests/test_scanner.js && node dist/tests/test_token_display.js && node dist/tests/test_regression.js
